title: Cursor Marketplace Schema
description: Local mirror of the upstream Cursor marketplace schema for the generated .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json — the Cursor-target counterpart to .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, listing only Cursor-enabled plugins.
$comment: Mirrored verbatim from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cursor/plugins/main/schemas/marketplace.schema.json (fetched and quoted directly, not paraphrased), cross-checked against the real example at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cursor/plugins/main/.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json. Snapshot date: 2026-08-21. No intentional divergence from upstream. Key differences from this repo's OWN codex-marketplace.schema.json (a local invention, not an upstream mirror): no root 'interface' wrapper (name is a bare top-level string, no displayName nesting); no per-entry 'policy' object; per-entry 'source' is a bare string (a relative path OR a remote URL per upstream — this repo's generator only ever emits the relative-path form, 'plugins/<name>'), not a { source: 'local', path } object.

metadata.description: additionalProperties: true per upstream — looser than the plugin manifest's own metadata handling.

plugins.description: Filtered to Cursor-enabled plugins only, in catalog canonical order. This repo never commits an empty-array empty-state artifact for Cursor (unlike Codex) — the root .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json is only emitted when at least one plugin is Cursor-enabled; absence is the no-op state.

name.description: Matches the plugin's name in its own .cursor-plugin/plugin.json, per upstream.

source.description: A relative path to the plugin directory or a remote URL per upstream (no further path-vs-URL discrimination in the schema itself). This repo's generator only emits the relative-path form.
